hooksMessagesPostMessage.hint: When on, this app may read and replace a completed user, tool, or assistant message while keeping its original role

hooksSessionBeforeCompact.label: Control session compaction
hooksSessionBeforeCompact.hint: When on, this app may cancel or provide the result of a session compaction before it runs

hooksProviderBeforeRequest.label: Rewrite requests to the model provider

hooksProviderBeforeHeaders.label: Read and change provider request headers
hooksProviderBeforeHeaders.hint: When on, this app may read, replace, or remove headers sent to a model provider, including authentication headers

sessionSwitchModel.label: Switch the session's model

sessionThinkingLevel.label: Change the session's thinking level
sessionThinkingLevel.hint: When on, this app may change how hard your session's model reasons before it answers — this changes how the session behaves for everyone who uses it afterwards

sessionPermissionMode.hint: When on, this app may change whether your session can act on your machine without asking first — this changes how the session behaves for everyone who uses it afterwards

tasksReadAll.label: Read all background tasks
tasksReadAll.hint: Let this app view tasks from Hana and other Apps. It cannot make changes.

modelsRead.label: Read provider model metadata

runtimeExecute.label: Run managed programs

runtimeNative.hint: Let this app run native programs. It may read other files on your computer, including private files and credentials. Only enable this for Apps you trust.

processSpawn.hint: Let this app start other programs. After you grant it, the App must restart before this takes effect.

uiOpenExternal.label: Open a link outside the app

uiClipboardWrite.label: Write to the clipboard

sessionToolsConfigure.label: Configure a session's next-run tools

resourcesWrite.label: Write authorized host resources
resourcesWrite.hint: Let this app write to host resources it is explicitly authorized to access.

mediaTasksManageAll.label: Manage all media tasks
mediaTasksManageAll.hint: Let this app manage host and other Apps' media tasks. It does not grant unrelated host access.

providerModelsManage.label: Manage provider media models
providerModelsManage.hint: Let this app change the host's provider media-model catalogue.

providerProvide.label: Provide a native model provider
providerProvide.hint: Let this app register its own model service as selectable models. When you use these models, conversation content is handled by this app.

providerAuth.label: Manage provider authentication
providerAuth.hint: Let this app manage its provider authentication information.

providerAuthEnvironment.label: Read provider authentication environment
providerAuthEnvironment.hint: Let this app read the model-service sign-in credentials that Hana allows.

servicesProvide.label: Provide App services
servicesProvide.hint: Let this app provide services to other Apps.

servicesCall.label: Call App services
servicesCall.hint: Let this app call services that another App has explicitly made available.

uiKeybindings.hint: Let this app register shortcuts in Hana's main window for its own tools. It does not create global system shortcuts.

uiMessageRenderers.label: Register message-to-card mappings

windowsManage.label: Manage App windows

environmentsManage.label: Manage isolated extension environments
environmentsManage.hint: Allow this App to create and manage separate extension environments. Their Apps, data and permissions remain isolated from installed extensions.

Send /newbot and follow the prompts to set a name and username

tutorialFsSteps: Go to open.feishu.cn, log in and open the Developer Console
Click "Create Enterprise Custom App", fill in the app name and description
On the "Credentials & Basic Info" page, copy the App ID and App Secret
Find "Add App Capabilities" in the left menu, add "Bot" capability and give it a name
Go to "Permissions", search and enable im:message (send and receive messages)
Go to "Events & Callbacks" → "Event Configuration", change to "Receive events via long connection"
Important: Go to "Version Management", create and publish a version first (long connection config requires a published app)
Paste the App ID and App Secret into the input fields above and turn on the switch
tutorialDtSteps: Go to open.dingtalk.com and open the Developer Console
Copy the enterprise Corp ID from the organization information
Create an internal enterprise app, then copy Client ID/AppKey and Client Secret/AppSecret from app credentials
Add the app robot capability and copy the Robot Code from the robot details
Make sure the app has the robot message permissions it needs and is published to the target enterprise scope
Keep API Base URL as https://api.dingtalk.com/v1.0 unless you intentionally use a DingTalk-compatible gateway
Paste Corp ID, Client ID, Client Secret, Robot Code, and API Base URL into the fields above. The token test and Stream connection must both succeed before replies can be sent

generateSpeech.description: Read given text aloud as speech. This is speech synthesis only: not music, not sound effects, and not transcribing an audio file into text. Pass exactly one of text (a single string) or texts (an array of 1-9 segments); each segment becomes its own audio, not one concatenated file. Non-blocking: the submission returns JSON task_ids. Submission does not complete the user's goal: continue independent work, and if the result is needed to complete the goal, pass those IDs to wait_for_tasks; otherwise it displays automatically when complete.

markdown.coverStyleGuide:
Hana Markdown cover default aesthetic guidelines:

1. Art style: modern Anime / animated movie key visual; do not use traditional Eastern stereotypical symbols as the default style.
2. Texture: strong paper texture, print grain, fine particles, warm material feel; like a frame bound into a paper book.
3. Narrative: cinematic, story-driven, literary atmosphere; prefer real scenes, character actions, lighting, prop relationships, and environmental traces to express the theme.
4. Content: extract imagery themes after reading the article; visualize the article's temperament rather than illustrating the summary word-for-word.
5. Fantasy: starry skies, fantasy, and literary imagery may appear, but must be naturally carried by the scene with real-world weight and emotional justification.
6. Restraint: avoid cheap AI-style floating symbol accumulation; surreal elements appear only when narratively necessary.
7. Theme: light mode uses soft warm light, low contrast, clean whitespace, visible paper fiber; dark mode uses low illumination, restrained highlights, dark areas preserving material layers.
8. Output: default to landscape 3:2 from the image generation tool; if the vendor doesn't support it, a close landscape ratio is acceptable, but never stretch the image.

themeTone.dark: Dark theme: low illumination, restrained highlights, dark areas still preserving paper fiber and material layers.
themeTone.light: Light theme: soft warm light, low contrast, clean whitespace, visible paper fiber.
